chunks: Whatever is in it from Mubārak al-ʿAqraqūfī, I have narrated it from al-Ḥusayn ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Tātānah—may Allah be pleased with him—from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm ibn Hāshim, from his father, from Muḥammad ibn Sinān, from Mubārak al-ʿAqraqūfī al-Asadī.

key_terms.الْأَسَدِيِّ: Al-Asadī; the tribal attribution identifying Mubārak more specifically.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; indicates direct authorial attribution of the report through a stated chain.
key_terms.مُبَارَكِ الْعَقْرَقُوفِيِّ: Mubārak al-ʿAqraqūfī, the narrator to whom the transmission route is being clarified.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Mubārak al-ʿAqraqūfī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Mubārak al-ʿAqraqūfī al-Asadī. It is a chain-of-transmission notice from the book’s mashyakhah, documenting the route of narration rather than conveying a legal or theological teaching.
